expected_plan.words: Inferred from the HCL, not planned: two roles, two role policies, one schedule, and the yang-lambda module's function and log group. The module's data source is a read and is not counted. No existing address is named, so nothing changes or is destroyed. The applier's plan must read 7 add, 0 change, 0 destroy.

schedule.words: The schedule is created DISABLED and stays DISABLED until the catch-up's after-read, by another act. Monday to Friday at 08:15 New York, the fire time the round-115 ruling accepted.

iam.words: Seven statements, each with explicit actions and derived resources. Execution: list under a prefix condition, read of two silver tables, one put on one gold prefix, own log stream; the function's trust is lambda.amazonaws.com. Scheduler: one invoke of the one function; its trust is scheduler.amazonaws.com. No delete action and no all-resources grant. The handler's default path lists the gold prefix to find the newest landed day, and no statement grants that list; this is recorded as a surprise row, not granted here.

artifact.words: The artifact key is read from the source-map entry's artifact_s3_key at plan time (locals.tf irpt_arc_artifact_key); the bucket is the yang-lambda module default. The entry's pins and hashes are null and stay null in this cell.

validated.words: No terraform binary on this box, so no init, validate, fmt or plan was run. Checked instead: the checker's HCL clauses (AC1 PASS), the naming gate over the root's diff (PASS, enforce on, 6 graded), the five names recomputed with lib/opal_naming.py name(), and the file hashes of the committed bytes.

derivations.scope: The scope is read from the registry: the declaration entry's registry_key names the vendor master row, whose firm field is the scope, as the producer's firm_scope() derives it (locals.tf irpt_arc_firm).
derivations.buckets: The gold bucket is the registry firm row's bucket field (locals.tf irpt_arc_gold_bucket), and the silver bucket is the declaration's bucket field (locals.tf irpt_arc_silver_bucket).
derivations.prefixes: The silver root is the declaration's monolith plus the derived firm plus the silver tier word (locals.tf irpt_arc_silver_root); the gold prefix is written inline in iam.tf from the address builder's constant segments, because Terraform cannot call lib/opal_naming.py.

words: A new Terraform root, nothing planned, applied or deployed. Five opal_name calls name the function, the two roles, the execution policy and the schedule; the scheduler role policy is named with the scheduler role's builder name, since the five-name list has no separate name for it. One yang-lambda module: handler.lambda_handler, timeout 900 s (the Lambda ceiling; five days at the round-122 measured 154 s per day on the sibling function is about 770 s), memory 8192 MB (the sibling's measured 4,025 MB peak is 49 percent of it; this function is unmeasured), reserved concurrency 1, and no environment variables. Two silver tables are read and one gold prefix is written; no delete and no wildcard. The schedule is DISABLED. Open: the default-path gold list (surprise rows filed in the channel).
